title: Define native Orderly order models and trader contracts
acceptance_criteria: Orderly regular orders, stop orders, and algo TP/SL orders have distinct model or enum representation in the shared exchange types and Orderly-specific models.
Orderly trader request builders can express single TP, single SL, and paired TP+SL submissions using native Orderly payload shapes.
Default TP/SL behavior remains single-order-at-a-time unless the caller explicitly submits both TP and SL together.
Validation or builder coverage documents how reduce-only, trigger fields, and quantity semantics map to Orderly APIs.
